summary: Operator page found (mhcfair.com): public nightly camping May-Oct outside the fair weeks, self-register, 50A + water, dump, no showers except fair week. $10 rate only on the county tourism listing. Website and phone should change; ownership class is a question.
flags: PUBLIC NIGHTLY: yes. The fair's own page: 'The Fairgrounds Campground is available to the public from May to October each year', self-register, 'Reservations not required, other than the week prior to the Fair, and the week of the Fair', and 'Open To All!'. Not event-only.

WEBSITE: stored https://www.howard-county.com/business/howard-county-fairgrounds-campground is the Howard County Business & Tourism directory listing (its 'Visit Website' link is a dead mhcfair.com/site/mhcf-visitors-camping.php, 404). The operator's page is https://mhcfair.com/visitors/ (Camping section). apply.py does not write website.
PHONE: stored 563-547-4240 appears on neither page. The fair office is (563) 547-4996 (mhcfair.com and the tourism listing). apply.py does not write phone.
FEES: the $10/night rate appears only on the county tourism listing; the fair's own page posts no rate. Fees left as stored.

OWNERSHIP: run by The Mighty Howard County Fair (Howard County Agricultural Society). Iowa county fair societies are usually non-profit corporations rather than county government; if so this is `private`, not `local`. Neither page says who legally owns it.
SEASON: operator says May-October (weather depending), tourism listing April-November and 'year-round camping'. Kept year_round false with both in season.note; no dates written.
FIT: 16 sites 70 ft deep fit a 23-ft motorhome; the 26 sites 30 ft deep probably do too. Long stays over 5 days need pre-approval.
PIN: stored pin is the fairgrounds' east gate on Elm St. I couldn't pick out the RV pads on Esri imagery, so no correction offered.
Note: the stored note repeated hookups, site counts, season and booking. Cleaned.
